reading.title: Fairy Tale Words
reading.purpose: Learn what we find in many fairy tales.
paras: Many fairy tales have a giant and a castle. A giant is very, very big. A castle has tall stone towers.
A hero is often brave. A hero may make a wish. Sometimes there is magic too. It is fun to read.

choices: A big stone house with towers.
qs.why: The reading says a castle has tall stone towers.

qs.q: Who is often brave in a fairy tale?
qs.why: The reading says the hero in a fairy tale is often brave.
The reading says the hero may make a wish.
